schemaComparison: Exact schema dump except random restrict markers and inline CHECK bodies; all CHECK definitions/validation compared with pg_get_constraintdef(pretty=true) from the same source snapshot
limitations: Synthetic local data only; not production backup or recovery proof
Cluster roles, extension binaries and local configuration reused, not restored
No object-storage blobs, external services or point-in-time recovery tested
Sequence values are restored by pg_restore but not compared against an MVCC table snapshot
Content digests establish equality, not clinical or programming validity
